name: clipscript
description: MCP connector for Clipscript: transcripts of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and X videos with TXT, SRT, VTT and JSON exports.
long_description: Paste a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook or X video link and get the transcript with timestamps. get_transcript transcribes one link and bulk_transcripts up to 10; list_channel_videos lists the latest videos of a YouTube channel, TikTok profile or Instagram profile. list_history, get_saved_transcript and export_transcript reopen saved transcripts as TXT, SRT, VTT or JSON, and get_usage shows your plan allowance. Every transcript is cached by video, and reopening one from your history is free.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Transcript of one video link, with optional timestamps.

tools.name: bulk_transcripts
tools.description: Transcripts of up to 10 video links in one call.

tools.name: list_channel_videos
tools.description: Latest videos of a YouTube channel, TikTok profile or Instagram profile.

tools.name: get_saved_transcript
tools.description: Full text of one saved transcript.

tools.name: export_transcript
tools.description: Export a saved transcript as TXT, SRT, VTT or JSON.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your plan and how much of the allowance is used.
